title: Sakkāya
text: 2-3 Etad avoca || || Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato katham passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyatīti || || 4-9 Cakkhum kho bhikkhu dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati || rūpe dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati || cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati || cakkhusamphassaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati || la || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukkhaṃ vā || tam pi dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahīyati || || 10 Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatīti || || [page 148] 148 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 166. 2
